description: Create an AI dubbing of a video into one target language. The path follows the video's subtitles, like the dashboard: target already subtitled → audio only (DUBBING, reuses that subtitle); source subtitled → TRANSLATION + dubbing; otherwise TRANSCRIPTION + dubbing (also creates the source subtitle). Costs 5 credits/min (standard) or 14 credits/min (lipsync) per language; minimum 1 min, a partial minute counts only past 1 s. Refuses lipsync on a video that already has standard dubbing (and the inverse), lipsync over 60 min, and a balance below the cost. Returns {video_id, path, from_lang, to_lang, cost_credits, response} — response is the queued work (for TRANSCRIPTION, the transcription work; the dubbing work is created when it finishes).

from_lang.description: Spoken (source) language code, e.g. 'pt-BR'. Default: the video's original language, else 'auto' (detected). Only used on the TRANSLATION/TRANSCRIPTION paths.

is_lipsync.description: Use LipSync (lip sync, 14 credits/min). Default: standard dubbing (5 credits/min)

num_speakers.description: Number of speakers in the video

replace_existing_subtitles.description: Same as the dashboard's 'Replace subtitles' option; only sent when the target language already has a subtitle. The API currently accepts it but does not regenerate the subtitle.

name: panda_create_ai_dubbing
title: Create AI Dubbing
